rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when continuing an activity from where it stopped.

example.english: After dinner, we resume watching the film.
example.traditional: 食完飯我哋繼續睇套戲。
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 faan6 ngo5 dei6 gai3 zuk6 tai2 tou3 hei3

rows.note: Use this especially when a service, operation, or normal activity resumes after being suspended.

example.english: After the power is restored, the hospital can resume normal operations.
example.traditional: 電力恢復後，醫院先可以正常運作。
example.jyutping: din6 lik6 fui1 fuk6 hau6 ji1 jyun2 sin1 ho2 ji5 zing3 soeng4 wan6 zok3
